title: Bubble Wrap Started Out as Wallpaper
hook: Bubble wrap began when two shower curtains were stuck together
summary: In 1957 two engineers sealed shower curtains together to trap air bubbles. They failed to sell it as wallpaper before it found its place as packaging.

text: Bubble wrap inside a parcel box.
But it did not start out as packaging.
In 1957 in New Jersey, two engineers
Air bubbles got trapped in between.
The two tried to sell it as wallpaper.

panels.text: A room walled in bubble wrap would never be boring

text: Next they sold it as greenhouse insulation.
Packaging packed with tiny air pockets.
Only in 1961 did people notice it protects goods.

panels.mean: The computer first shipped wrapped in it

panels.text: A failed wallpaper ended up protecting computers
